prompt: Generate a long greenhouse occupying exactly 3x2 cells of 128px each (384x256 footprint), with 128px visible height. Keep a central ground anchor, the shared grid scale, and the complete transparent silhouette. Deliver each sprite in a 512x576px frame with local projected ground anchor (256,376). Save original generated images, exact prompts, all references, processed sprites, result.json, and review previews in {{OUTPUT_DIR}}.

visualChecks.projection: Screen-aligned square grid; top and front readable; parallel edges, no depth-dependent scale or camera drift.
visualChecks.complete-art: Full silhouette and effects fit the declared frame; no clipped limbs or undeclared shadows.
visualChecks.anchor-placement: Ground/root location matches the guide independently of alpha bounds or visible toe tips.
visualChecks.rectangular-size: The footprint remains a 3:2 rectangle at the same cell scale, without forcing a square or stretching axes.
visualChecks.multi-cell-overlap: Inspect complete placement and tall-row overlap; report when independent depth pieces are needed.
visualChecks.source-faithfulness: Compare original generated sources with processed sprites and declared operations; no invented replacement art or unreported geometry fitting.
